description: This is the main entry point for the rusEfi ECU console application. The class Launcher initializes and manages the UI, handles connection establishment, manages various tabs including gauges, logs, engine sniffer, settings, and fuel tuning. It also manages application lifecycle events such as opening and closing the main window, and communicates with the ECU hardware through different protocols.

classes.name: Launcher
